name: pps-analytics
description: Typed analytics CLI for the PPS Logseq zettelkasten mirror.

scripts.inspect: pnpm run build && node dist/src/cli/bin/cli.js inspect
scripts.build:analytics: pnpm run build && node dist/src/cli/bin/cli.js build
scripts.watch:analytics: pnpm run build && node dist/src/cli/bin/cli.js watch
scripts.serve:dac: pnpm run build && node dist/src/cli/bin/cli.js serve-dac
